== Also in (Datacard Grok, 10 November 2026) ==
White [[Imperial Barrier]] leftover products of this version: [[Enhanced Premiere]] boosters, [[First Anthology]] starters, [[Reflections]] / [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] / [[Reflections III]] bulk. Premiere Two-Player is a named edition of the same cardboard (stacked title dest later), not Also in. Set icon is none. == Also in: leftover products removed (11 November 2026) ==
Removed [[Enhanced Premiere]], [[First Anthology]], [[Reflections]], [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] and [[Reflections III]] from Also in, leaving only [[Premiere Unlimited]], like the other 59 Premiere Two-Player reprints (swccg-guild/work#274 Q4). Nothing found names the white-border Imperial Barrier in those products. The [[SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia]] 3.2 (pp. 19–23, 26) only says those products held random Premiere Unlimited cards or packs (Enhanced Premiere: four Premiere Unlimited packs; First Anthology: two Premiere Unlimited starter decks; Reflections I–III: random white-border Premiere cards). That applies to every Premiere Unlimited card alike, and the list also left out [[Second Anthology]], which held eight Premiere Unlimited packs. The Reflections II tie to Imperial Barrier is the wrapper-redemption foil (Enc 3.2 p. 34), a separate version: [[Imperial Barrier (Promotional Foil)]]. Whether every Unlimited card should list products that carried random Unlimited cards is a #244 question.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 19–23, 26, 34.
